{{Quote|Now, if anyone asks, we're farmers from Tawl and you're my daughter.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Leia Organa|<ref name="Kenobi Part II">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref>}}
'''Tawl''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Convergence">''[[The High Republic: Convergence]]''</ref> in the [[Tawl system]] in the [[Tungra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> During the [[Eiram and E'ronoh War|Forever War]] between the [[planet]]s [[Eiram]] and [[E'ronoh]], [[refugee]]s traveled from Eiram to Tawl aboard [[Starship|barges]].<ref name="Convergence" /> By the middle of the [[Imperial Era]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' is set ten [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' must be set in [[9 BBY]].</ref> Tawl was under the authority of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Kenobi Part III" /> As part of a [[Ambush on Alderaan|rescue mission]] in [[9 BBY]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disguised both [[Gender|himself]] and a young [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] in local attire, giving the young girl the alibi that they were [[farmer]]s who hailed from Tawl.<ref name="Kenobi Part II" /> [[Freck]], an Imperial sympathizer on [[Mapuzo]], considered the people in Tawl to be good people as they "paid their way and listened to the Empire."<ref name="Kenobi Part III" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tawl was first mentioned in "[[Part II]]" of the [[2022]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''.<ref name="Kenobi Part II" />
